scheme_name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana - Central Financial Assistance to Residential Consumers (capex mode)
description: Central Financial Assistance for grid-connected residential rooftop solar under PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (MNRE). Rs 30,000 per kWp for the first 2 kWp and Rs 18,000 for the third kWp; nothing beyond 3 kWp. This row applies everywhere except the special-category States/UTs, which have a separate row with higher rates.

source.name: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), Government of India
source.document: Guidelines for PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana - Central Financial Assistance to Residential Consumers (OM No. 318/17/2024-GCRT dated 07.06.2024, published on MNRE 02.07.2024)
source.section: Clause 5 Central Financial Assistance; clause 2(d) implementation period
source.excerpt: Effective CFA: Residential Sector (first 2 kWp of RTS capacity or part thereof): Rs 30,000/kWp; Residential Sector (with additional RTS capacity of 1 kWp or part thereof): Rs 18,000/kWp; Residential Sector (additional RTS capacity beyond 3 kWp): No additional CFA. Example iii: a 6 kW system is eligible for 30,000x2 + 18,000x1 = 78,000. Clause 5(d): No CFA will be provided to non-residential segments of consumers (including government segment, commercial and industrial segment etc.). Clause 2(d): The implementation period of the scheme shall be till 31st March, 2027.

verification_notes: Amounts read directly from the MNRE guideline PDF (SHA-256 2de9b3faf765c18b..., 57 pages). Amendment check: MNRE Office Memorandum No. 318/140/2024-GCRT Part (1) dated 13.02.2025 clarifies that ground-mounted elevated installations are allowed and does NOT change any CFA amount; no other change to the CFA rates was found on MNRE's PM Surya Ghar document list. 2026 status: PIB press release of 24 Mar 2026 confirms MNRE is implementing the scheme (target one crore households by FY 2026-27), so it is not treated as expired; effective_to is the guideline's own implementation end (31 Mar 2027) and a later extension would be added as a new version. Cross-check: TNPDCL's published 'Subsidy Structure of PM-Surya Ghar Scheme' (1 kW Rs 30,000; 2 kW Rs 60,000; 3 kW and above Rs 78,000) matches. The special-category States/UTs listed in clause 5(g) (Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, J&K, Ladakh, North-East States including Sikkim, A&N Islands, Lakshadweep) are excluded here and covered by the PMSG-CFA-2024.02-SPECIAL-CATEGORY row; 'States in the North East' is applied as the eight NE States. Stacking: clause 5(i) allows State/UT governments to supplement the CFA, so central + state is recorded as combinable; combinability with DISCOM incentives is not stated and is left unverified. The CFA is by installed module DC capacity (clause 5(k)); domestic-content modules are required (clause 5(m)). This app does not check those conditions and reports the amount as the scheme's entitlement for the proposed capacity only.
